Mission Local reported that Aaron Peskin attended a tense Noe Valley meeting about housing and zoning, where residents worried about a wave of taller buildings. He backed the western-neighborhood upzoning, which he had helped write, while arguing that the housing crisis was driven in part by financing costs, not just neighborhood opposition. He also pointed to affordable-housing efforts and tried to balance support for new housing with protections for existing residents.
